name: Carmen
self_text: I am a Mexican in my early 20s who loves playing chess online. I use a Fuji camera. I am looking for a relaxed photo walk. I tend to go at a moderate pace. I am cool with not taking portraits of each other. Most weeks I can do Sunday morning or weekday evenings.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into a relaxed photo walk. I'd strongly prefer that you are okay with a fast pace or a slow pace, though it's not a requirement. It would matter a lot if you are okay with not taking portraits of each other, but I won't rule you out over it. It's a small bonus if you are available Sunday morning or weekday evenings.
